tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:ROOT: Everything from Thaumic Dyes and Thaumic Exploration, with plain-language ability notes.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.ROOT.1: This branch has no lore - it just says what each item does. Every node lists the effect, the numbers and the limits in plain language, so you can look things up quickly.
tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:RUNIC: A shield that absorbs hits before your health does.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.RUNICARM: Runic armor grants a runic shield: damage hits the shield first and only reaches your health when it is empty. Charge per piece: helmet 8, chestplate 24, leggings 16, boots 8 - 56 for a full set. The shield value and its recharge are handled by Thaumcraft itself, so there is nothing to manage.
tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:RUNIC: See aura nodes and cut all vis costs by 5%.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.RUNICGOG: Wearing these reveals nearby aura nodes (same as the Goggles of Revealing) and cuts all of your vis costs by 5%. They also count as runic armor with 8 runic charge.
tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:RUNIC: I to II to III: more charge and more upgrade slots.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.RUNICUPG: Runic armor can be pushed further on the infusion altar: I to II to III. Each tier has more charge and defense, and tier III (Primal) has three upgrade slots and a full robe look. Recipes are on the following pages.
tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:TRAVE: Step up blocks, run faster, jump higher, fall softer.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.TRAVELLE: All three ordinary traveller boots do the same job: step up one block automatically, run faster, jump higher and fall softer. Boots of the Explorer is the balanced one, Boots of the Wanderer runs fastest and falls softest, Runic Boots of the Traveller adds a runic shield and one upgrade slot. Numbers: step height +0.4 (a full block), speed +15% to +30%, jump +0.275 blocks, fall distance reduced by 0.25 to 0.5 per tick.
tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:CRYST: 2% off all vis costs, and it counts as runic armor.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.CRYSTALA: The full crystal set cuts all vis costs by 2%, and every piece counts as runic armor with runic charge. Defense is 2 / 3 / 2 for head, chest and legs and 1 for boots - its value is the discount, not raw protection.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.BRAINCUR: Pure Zombie Brain. It cannot be eaten or worn; it is the material for the necromancer staff rod and the other necromancy recipes in this mod.
tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:ROD_T: Spreads surplus vis into the aspects that are low.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.ROD_TRAN: Transmutation rod: capacity 75. It works while the wand sits in your inventory - every 4 ticks it takes whatever is above 90% of a primal aspect and gives three quarters of it to the aspects below 90%, spreading the rest back out. The result is that all six aspects stay roughly even.
tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:ROD_A: Tiny capacity, but it recharges itself.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.ROD_AMBE: Amber rod: only 10 capacity, but every 5 seconds it adds 1 vis to each aspect that is not full - a wand that recharges itself while sitting in your bag.
tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:ROD_B: No combat use. It just talks sometimes.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.ROD_BREA: Bread rod: capacity 39 and no combat ability whatsoever. Its only function is to say something once in a while (one in a thousand ticks). That is the whole feature.
tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:ROD_N: Drinks nearby aspect orbs at 4.33x value.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.ROD_NECR: Necromancer staff rod: capacity 200. It drinks aspect orbs within 3 blocks and stores them at 4.33x value - the fastest way to stock up vis, as long as there are orbs around.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.CAP_SOJO: Caps decide how much vis each cast costs. The Sojourner cap multiplies the cost by 0.95 (5% cheaper) with a craft cost of 6 - identical to the Mechanist cap, so pick whichever looks better.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.CAP_MECH: The Mechanist cap also multiplies vis cost by 0.95 (5% cheaper) with a craft cost of 6. Same numbers as the Sojourner cap; only the look and the name differ.
tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:ACCES: Six small trinkets that work while worn.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.ACCESSOR: Six trinkets that work while worn in a Curios slot. Discount Ring: all vis costs -3%. Stabilizer Belt: +1 knockback resistance, so the altar will not throw you around. Nutrient Talisman: every 20 ticks it sweeps your hotbar and stores food that has no potion effects (up to 100 of each kind), then feeds you when you are hungry.
tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:SEALS: A blank seal. Currently just a crafting ingredient.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.SEALS.1: A blank seal, currently only a crafting ingredient. The original chest and jar seals needed a whole world-level shared inventory system (block, block entity and saved data) that this port does not have, so those items were not kept.
tooltip.thaumicdyesexplor.wand_rod.hint: Click a rod, then a cap, on the arcane workbench or infusion altar to assemble a wand.
thaumicdyesexplor.bread.2: The bread has seen things. The bread says nothing.
thaumicdyesexplor.bread.4: Somewhere, a baker weeps for no reason.
tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:DYEIN: Any dye plus any armor with a cloth layer recolours it.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.DYEING.1: Any single dye combined with any armor that has a cloth layer can be crafted in a grid (2x2 or larger). Only the cloth layer takes the colour; the metal, gilded and plate layers keep their original look. Dyed armor can be re-dyed as often as you like - the new colour simply overwrites the old one.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.DYEING.2: Armor with a cloth layer (names as they appear in your inventory): the Cultist set (Cultist Hood / Cultist Robe / Cultist Leggings), the Thaumium Robe set, the Bleached Void Robe set, the Enhanced Fortress set, the Praetor set, the Knight set (Cultist Helmet / Chestplate / Greaves), and the dyed Ranger and Archer pieces. Iron Fortress, Sun Knight, Husk plate, Runic armor, Crystal armor, all traveller boots and the Mask of Evil cannot be dyed.
tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:RUNIC: Runic shield plus a traveller stride.
tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:ARMOR: Six dyeable armor sets, plus dyed and plain ranger / archer variants.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.ARMORSET: Six dyeable sets: Cultist Robes, Thaumium Robe, Void Robe, Fortress Armor, Praetor Armor and Knight Armor; Ranger and Archer armor additionally come in dyed and plain versions. Only the cloth takes dye - the metal and plate parts always stay original. Defense (head / chest / legs): robes, knight and ranger are 2 / 6 / 5; void robe, fortress and praetor are 3 / 7 / 6.

Fortress Armor is plate plus a surcoat: the chest gem, pauldrons and skirt plates are fixed metal pieces and only the surcoat takes dye, so the same armor looks very different in different colours. The original mod also hid or showed extra decorations based on how many pieces you wear; that part is not ported yet, so the armor always shows its plain shape - defense and dyeing still work.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.RUNICARM: Each piece has upgrade slots: 1 for tiers I and II, 3 for tier III (Primal). A shield node upgrade adds 50% charge to that piece - 2.5x with all three slots filled on tier III. The armor also repairs its own durability, faster the more Warlord upgrades you wear.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.TRAVELLE: Two more are special, and both are infusion upgrades: Boots of the Explorer to Boots of the Meteor, then to Boots of the Comet. Meteor boots: jumping while sneaking launches you along your look direction and you slam the ground on landing, with a bigger explosion the longer you were airborne (1 / 2 / 3 blocks past 5 / 10 / 15 ticks), costing 1 durability per slam. Comet boots freeze the water under you as you walk (radius 5, an 11x11 area), so you can run across water.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.RUNICUPG: Four upgrades work passively: 7 Steadfast (+20% knockback resistance), 8 Vitality (+10 max health), 9 Haste (+3% speed, boots only), 10 Warlord (+2 attack damage). The other four (1, 3, 4, 6) only fire when the shield breaks, and the 1.21.1 API does not expose the current shield value, so they are not implemented.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.RUNICBOO: Runic charge on your feet: 8 runic charge plus one upgrade slot, with every traveller bonus kept - step up blocks, faster running, higher jumps and softer falls. Wear these if you want both.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.ACCESSOR: Dreamcatcher: 3/4 chance to take no damage at all from tainted creatures, taint damage or tentacle damage. Tentacle Ring: when hit while standing on the ground, it summons a taintacle to fight for you. Taint Ring: wearing it makes you immune to the Taint effect and slowly restores hunger in tainted land; but wearing it outside tainted land starts withdrawal damage - and taking it off kills you outright.
tc.research_text.thaumicdyesexplor:ARMOR: One base armor plus one cloth gives you an armor that takes dye.
thaumicdyesexplor.research_page.ARMORMAD: Every dyeable armor is crafted the same way: one base armor plus one Crimson Fabric, anywhere in a crafting grid (shapeless). Crimson Fabric is one white wool and two string. Once sewn, the piece has a cloth layer and any single dye will colour it.
